title: Announcement: Appellate Committee Decisions – Advertisement Nos. 60, 61 & 62 (2025)
labels: Notifications From Office of The Registrar
text:
Appellate Committee Decisions

Applicants who submitted appeals against the decisions of the Scrutiny & Quantification Committee may now view the decisions of the Appellate Committee by logging into the following portal using their existing credentials:

https://jobs.awkum.edu.pk/applicants/appeals

Important Instructions:

Applicants for the positions of Professor and Associate Professor, who were earlier declared ineligible by the Scrutiny Committee but have now been declared eligible by the Appellate Committee, are required to submit an evaluation fee of Rs. 6,000/- for further processing of their applications.

The decision of the Appellate Committee shall be treated as final as per the relevant provisions of the Statutes.

The provisional merit list will be uploaded in due course.

In cases where an appeal has been accepted subject to verification, the marks awarded shall remain provisional and may be revoked if the claim is found unsubstantiated upon verification.
